data_retention_note: Hugging Face forwards each request to the pinned third-party provider (DeepInfra), whose own data-retention policy applies. Lab camera images and depth data sent with every call leave this machine.
model_verified: 2026-10-02: router.huggingface.co/v1/models lists Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (Apache-2.0) with image+text input; a re-fetch the same day (after the live smoke) lists providers novita (no structured output), featherless-ai, ovhcloud and deepinfra, and no longer lists cerebras. deepinfra: status live, supports_structured_output true, 262,144-token context. The model card documents thinking on by default, reasoning_effort xhigh (default) / medium / low, thinking sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95, and reasoning returned as reasoning / reasoning_content. Vision and reasoning both verified.
notes: MLLM-01 per 15-CONTEXT.md D-13/D-15/D-20/D-21/D-23. Re-pinned from cerebras to deepinfra by user decision on 2026-10-02 (15-LIVE-RESULTS.md section 2): the Plan 15-10 live smoke got HTTP 503 twice from cerebras ('currently failing ... paused by the circuit breaker'), and the router listing fetched that day no longer offers cerebras for this model. deepinfra has structured output and a 262,144-token context, which holds the ~15K-token prompt plus the 32000-token reasoning budget with the 16000-token prompt reserve (Pitfall 10); prices $0.20 input / $2.50 output per million tokens (2026-10-02). A provider pin is still required because unpinned :fastest routing can land on a provider without structured output (novita has none; research C2, Pitfall 2). effort xhigh is the model's highest level (research C11). The shared sampling 1.0 / 0.95 is sent as-is; whether the provider honours it is confirmed live. Cost is cents per call (research C1); no model on the router is free. No replacement from the D-23 shortlist (google/gemma-4-31B-it, zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) was needed: all three HF models passed the vision and reasoning checks. The re-smoke for this variant (Plan 15-10) must confirm routing to the pinned provider, reasoning tokens and reasoning text under json_schema mode (assumptions A3/A4) and image acceptance (A6; set image_format to jpeg if the provider rejects the request size). If the pinned provider rejects json_schema, a human sets structured_mode to json_object (schema in the system prompt, client-side validation); there is no automatic fallback. api_key_env names the environment variable holding a fine-grained HF token with Inference Providers permission; never put the token itself in this file.
